fields.FIR_Description: As per the FIR recorded on 2025-04-11, an investment offer shared in a messaging group led Madhan Kumar to deposit Rs. 4,50,000, after which contact ended. The time of the incident was given as 09:20 on 2025-04-09. Eswari Raj (mobile 9000000433) was named as a possible person of interest. The complainant mentioned the account SYN-ACC-100069 as the destination of the transfer. Elango Krishnan (9000000081) noticed the incident and may be able to provide a statement. Items referenced in the complaint: transaction records.
fields.Modus_Operandi: Victim allegedly persuaded to deposit funds with a promise of high returns.
fields.Keywords: investment fraud, high returns, apartment complex, receiving account, suspect, morning, mobile number, witness
